FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 255 would increase the obligations of the Department of Senior Services by an estimated $175 per meeting of the advisory board of directors to the Department of Senior Services to reimburse the additional member of the advisory board added by this bill.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
